digest_markdown:
• [1] A supply chain attack on SolarWinds' Orion IT monitoring system, used by over 30,000 organizations, was compromised by hackers, allowing them to deliver backdoor malware in an Orion software update. [1]
• [1] A compromised LiteLLM 1.107.0 release was published to the Python Package Index (PyPI) and distributed through official container images, allowing hackers to steal credentials and access sensitive information. [2]
• [1] A GhostAction supply chain campaign compromised 3,325 secrets, exposing tokens and keys across widely used platforms including PyPI, npm, DockerHub, GitHub, AWS, and Cloudflare. [3]
• [2] A GhostAction supply chain campaign compromised 772 public GitHub repositories, using fake GitHub Actions workflow files to steal credentials from CI/CD environments. [4]
• [4] The GhostAction campaign used stolen GitHub account access to add malicious workflows under the victim's own identity, sending stolen data over plain HTTP to an attacker-controlled infrastructure. [4]
